nodes.description: List of conceptual nodes identified in the text.

id.description: A unique identifier for the node (e.g. alphanumeric or kebab-case slug based on the label).

label.description: Short name representing the concept, event, or object.

category.description: The category classification of the node based on contextual content.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the node to be displayed in the side panel.

edges.description: List of relationships or connections between nodes.

source.description: The ID of the source node.

target.description: The ID of the target node.

label.description: Optional label text explaining the relationship (e.g., 'depends on', 'creates', 'defines').
